- changelog:
    - lyrics basic stats added
    - lyrics sentiment analysis added
- columns
    - acousticness
    - instrumentalness
    - liveness
    - speechiness
    - loudness
    - tempo
    - duration_ms
    - key
    - mode
    - year
    - genre / one-hot encoded
    - lyrics basic stats
        - word_count
        - unique_word_count
        - unique_ratio
        - avg_word_length
        - char_count
    - lyrics sentiment analysis
        - sentiment_polarity
        - sentiment_subjectivity
- only english language
- approx 550,000 songs
